messages:
maya (docs): Hey team — opened a docs PR to tighten SOC2 language around audit logs, redaction, and retention: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/341. Can you eyeball the phrasing? cc @alex (security) @lina (compliance)

alex (security): Thanks — quick read. Two high-level asks: (1) avoid absolute promises like 'we never store' — prefer 'we retain according to policy and delete on schedule'. (2) separate hosted vs dedicated behavior in the retention wording.

lina (compliance): +1 to Alex. Also we should include a short line about customer-controlled retention for Dedicated/Private (so legal teams can point to it).

jin (devex): For the SDK snippet we should show how to opt-in/opt-out of user-input capture and how to set `redact_user_input`. Draft snippet suggestion below — is this accurate?

jin (devex): ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=TOKEN)
# disable storing raw user input in hosted audit logs
client.config.audit.record_user_input = False
# ask server to redact sensitive fields when possible
client.config.audit.redact_user_input = True
```

sam (eng): Snippet looks fine but our runtime flag is `audit.capture_user_input` in v2 of the SDK. Also mention storage encryption at rest and per-tenant KMS for Dedicated. Suggest replacing `client.config.audit.record_user_input` with `client.config.audit.capture_user_input`.

maya (docs): Good catch, Sam. I'll update the snippet. Also Lina — what default retention window should we state for hosted? The PR currently says 90 days.

lina (compliance): 90 days is reasonable as a default for hosted, but add: "customers can request extended retention (audit) under contract; Dedicated/Private can configure retention via admin controls."

alex (security): Add a short note about redaction not being perfect — "redaction attempts may not remove embedded sensitive data in binary blobs" — so teams know limitations.

maya (docs): Will add that nuance and a short table: Hosted default 90 days; Dedicated: customer-configurable; Private: customer-managed. Also adding a short migration note for SDK v1 -> v2 config keys.

sam (eng): One more nit: include the internal log key names used by the runtime so ops can map the docs to traces. i.e., `audit:event`, `audit:user_id_hash`, `audit:payload_redacted`

maya (docs): adding those. PR updated to include revised snippet + table + limitation note. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/341 (ready for review) :eyes:

compliance-bot: label "docs/soc2" added to PR #341 by automation.

alex (security): I'll do a pass later today — focusing on legal phrasing and the redaction caveat.

jin (devex): After Alex signs off I can add the finalized snippet to the SDK quickstart and a small migration blurb for customers upgrading their config keys.

maya (docs): Thanks all. If nobody objects, I'll merge after Alex + Lina approve. :sparkles:
